payload.explanation: Diagnostic report_429006679739 attributes the stuck inventory decrement to lock contention: the business session_795a05a0b167 is blocked on transactionid by session_5b2f5d74cd3f, an idle-in-transaction session holding the row lock after executing the same UPDATE. State report_a8476921d758 confirms session_5b2f5d74cd3f is eligible for rollback_session, while the business request itself must not be modified directly. Rolling back the blocker releases the lock, allowing the business request to complete and stock to reach 99; the other eligible session (session_8865cb822f87) is unrelated and must be preserved.
